about: Evaluation set for search_docs (STP-1061). Realistic developer/agent questions about STP, each with the resource URIs that answer it. A question is a hit when any expected URI is among the pages of the top 5 passages (recall@5). noGoodSource marks questions the pinned docs and contract do not answer well today; their expected list holds the closest partial sources (possibly none) and their gap note feeds STP-1062. generatedReference lists pages of the generated API reference (docs/api, docs/api-net, not bundled) that would also answer; it is used only to measure whether bundling that reference helps.

questions.gap: No guide on COAs. The docs only say the COA methods are not dispatched by the engine; what an integration should do instead (and what CoaSwitched/SetRole do to COAs) is not explained.

questions.question: In what order do events arrive after I load a scenario - NewScenario, SymbolAdded, TaskAdded, TaskOrg events?
questions.gap: Event ordering (after a load, a join, a sync or an undo) is not documented anywhere.

questions.question: Which JSON-RPC error codes can STP return and what does each mean?
questions.gap: json-api shows one error example (-32601); there is no list of error codes or of when STP answers with an error versus success=false.

questions.question: How do I tell a refused request from one that timed out?
questions.gap: Refusals ('No handler') are covered, but timeout behaviour (default 30 s in the JS SDK, what happens to a late reply, retries) and how to distinguish the two are not.

questions.question: How should my app reconnect after the WebSocket connection drops?
questions.gap: Connection loss and reconnection (re-registering, re-joining the scenario, missed events) are not documented.

questions.question: How do I connect and receive symbol events with the .NET SDK?
questions.gap: All guides are written for the JavaScript SDK; the .NET SDK has only its generated reference (ConnectAndRegisterAsync etc.), no guide.

questions.question: Which API methods only read state and which ones modify or delete the scenario?
questions.gap: Neither the docs nor the contract classify methods as read / write / destructive yet (x-stpSafety, STP-1059).

questions.question: What happens when two clients edit the same symbol at the same time?
questions.gap: Only the sync rules (newer timestamp wins) are described; concurrent live edits, locking and conflict notification are not.

questions.question: How do I install and run the STP engine itself, for example in Docker or on Linux?
questions.gap: The docs assume an engine is already running (Windows server, v5.9.9+); installing, configuring and hosting the engine is not covered.

questions.question: How do I set the time window or phase of a symbol or task for synchronization?
questions.gap: timeFrom/timeTo and startTime/endTime are listed as properties, but phases, time formats and how timing drives C2SIM orders are not explained.

questions.question: What endpoints does the REST connector expose and how do I post symbols to it?
questions.gap: The REST connector is referred to (POST /symbols, ?replace=true, ?append=true) but has no reference page of its endpoints and payloads.
